semitangent.definition: n. The tangent of half an arc.

semite.definition:
n. a member of a group of Semitic-speaking peoples of the Middle East and northern Africa
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Semites

semiterrestrial.definition: a chiefly but not exclusively terrestrial
semiterrestrial.translation: a. 半陆生的, 在沼泽生长的； 半陆栖的

semitertian malaria.translation: [医] 半间日疟, 日发间日混合疟

semites.definition:
plural of semite
n. a member of a group of Semitic-speaking peoples of the Middle East and northern Africa
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Semites
semites.translation: (semite 的复数) n. 闪族人；闪米特人

semitic.definition:
n. a major branch of the Afro-Asiatic language family
a. of or relating to the group of Semitic languages
semitic.translation: a. 闪米特人的, 犹太人的

semitics.definition: n. a major branch of the Afro-Asiatic language family
semitics.translation: n. 研究闪族语言、文学和文化之学

semitism.definition: n. A Semitic idiom; a word of Semitic origin.
semitism.translation: n. 闪族人特质；闪族语

semitist.translation: n. 闪米特语言专家；闪米特文化(或历史)专家

semitize.translation: vt.(在语言等方面)使闪米特化

semitone.definition: n. the musical interval between adjacent keys on a keyboard instrument
semitone.translation:
n. 半音, 半音程
[电] 半音

semitones.definition: n. the musical interval between adjacent keys on a keyboard instrument
semitones.translation: n. 半音, 半音程( semitone的复数形式 )

semitonic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a semitone; consisting of a
   semitone, or of semitones.

semitrailer.definition: n. a trailer having wheels only in the rear; the front is supported by the towing vehicle
semitrailer.translation: n. 半拖车, 双轮拖车

semitranslucent.definition:
a. Slightly clear; transmitting light in a slight
   degree.

semitransparent.definition: s allowing light to pass through diffusely
semitransparent.translation:
a. 半透明的
[医] 半透明的

semitropic.definition: a of or relating to or characteristic of conditions in the subtropics
semitropic.translation: a. 亚热带的, 副热带的

semitropical.definition: a of or relating to or characteristic of conditions in the subtropics

semitropics.definition: n regions adjacent to the tropics
